nodes.label: 任务目标
nodes.reasonEn: Walk to the silver trash bin

nodes.label: 接近前方白柱
nodes.reason: 当前画面尚未出现银色垃圾桶。前方过道通向带安全出口标识的白柱。先接近柱前，再观察两侧尚未看清的区域。
nodes.reasonEn: The silver trash bin is not visible yet. The aisle leads to a white column with an exit sign. Approach the column, then inspect the areas on either side.
nodes.instruction: Go to the white pillar in front.
nodes.sourceInstruction: Go straight to the white pillar with the green exit sign.

nodes.label: 向左观察走廊
nodes.reason: 已到达白柱前，正前方是柱体和玻璃，仍未看到目标。向左观察尚未检查的方向。
nodes.reasonEn: The robot has reached the column. The column and glass are directly ahead, and the target is still out of view. Look left to inspect that side.

nodes.label: 接近疑似垃圾桶
nodes.reason: 左转后，右前方白墙旁可见灰色立式物体，外形接近垃圾桶。沿瓷砖通道靠近，确认是否为目标。
nodes.reasonEn: A grey upright object beside the wall ahead on the right looks like a bin. Approach along the tiled corridor to check whether it is the target.
nodes.instruction: Go to the grey bin on the front-right.
nodes.sourceInstruction: Go straight down the corridor towards the grey cylindrical bin near the glass wall on the right.

nodes.label: 到达垃圾桶旁
nodes.reason: 机器人已停下，银色金属垃圾桶就在右前方，桶盖和桶身清楚可见。当前相机画面支持已到达目标旁的判断。
nodes.reasonEn: The robot has stopped beside a silver metal trash bin on the front-right. Its lid and body are clearly visible in the robot camera, supporting the arrival check.

edit.alignment: Continuous capture-timestamp timeline aligned to the phone recording. Only endpoints are trimmed; all in-run waiting and movement are retained.

pantry.provenanceZh: 节点说明依据录像与运行记录复盘。
pantry.provenanceEn: Decision notes reconstructed from the recording and run log.

nodes.label: 接近前方白柱
nodes.reason: 当前画面还未出现茶水间。前方过道通向带安全出口标识的白柱。先接近柱前，再观察两侧通路。
nodes.reasonEn: The pantry is not visible yet. The aisle leads to a white column with an exit sign. Approach the column, then inspect the paths on either side.
nodes.instruction: Go to the white pillar in front.
nodes.sourceInstruction: Go straight to the white pillar with the green exit sign and stop in front of it.

nodes.label: 向右观察
nodes.reason: 已到达白柱前，柱体和玻璃挡住正前方。先向右观察，确认这一侧是否有可通行的走廊。
nodes.reasonEn: The robot has reached the column, with the column and glass directly ahead. Look right to check for a passable corridor.

nodes.label: 沿走廊导航
nodes.reason: 右转后，前方是沿玻璃窗延伸的瓷砖走廊，右侧是办公区，暂时未见茶水间入口。沿走廊继续前进，再观察前方两侧区域。
nodes.reasonEn: After the right turn, a tiled corridor extends along the windows, with desks on the right. The pantry entrance is not visible yet. Continue along the corridor to inspect the areas ahead.
nodes.instruction: Walk forward along the tiled corridor.
nodes.sourceInstruction: Walk straight along the tiled corridor, past the white pillars beside the glass windows, to the lounge with blue seats. Stop in front of the white pillar beside the tall black shelf.

nodes.label: 向左观察
nodes.reason: 前方白柱左侧出现黑色高架和休闲座椅，与刚才的办公区不同。吧台还未看清，先向左观察这片区域。
nodes.reasonEn: A tall black shelf and lounge seating are now visible to the left of the white column, beyond the office area. The counter is not yet clear. Look left to inspect this area.

nodes.label: 转回原朝向
nodes.reason: 左转后正对玻璃，不能从这里直接进入；右侧只露出部分室内空间。先转回刚才的走廊朝向，再前移换一个观察位置。
nodes.reasonEn: The left turn reveals glass directly ahead, blocking entry here. Only part of the interior is visible on the right. Return to the previous corridor heading, then move forward to try another viewpoint.

nodes.label: 前移调整观察位置
nodes.reason: 已转回走廊朝向，黑色高架旁的白柱和左侧座椅仍可见。先靠近这根白柱，再重新检查左侧通路。
nodes.reasonEn: Back at the corridor heading, the white column beside the black shelf and the seating to its left are visible. Approach this column before checking the left-hand route again.
nodes.instruction: Approach the white pillar next to the tall black shelf.
nodes.sourceInstruction: Walk closer to the white pillar beside the tall black shelf. Stop on the open tiled floor immediately in front of that pillar, near the black shelf.

nodes.label: 再次向左观察
nodes.reason: 已经靠近白柱，正前方是柱面，不能继续直走。刚才看到的休闲区在左侧，再次左转，确认新位置是否能看清通路。
nodes.reasonEn: The robot is now close to the column, with its surface directly ahead. The lounge seen earlier is on the left. Look left again to check the route from this new position.

nodes.label: 接近吧台
nodes.reason: 这次左转后，玻璃位于左侧，前方通道已经展开；右前方可见台面、柜体和饮水设备，与茶水间相符。沿通道接近吧台。
nodes.reasonEn: After this left turn, the glass is on the left and the passage ahead is in view. A countertop, cabinets and a water dispenser ahead on the right identify the pantry area. Approach the counter along the passage.
nodes.instruction: Go to the pantry counter on the front-right.
nodes.sourceInstruction: Walk towards the wooden pantry counter on the front-right.

nodes.label: 确认到达吧台旁
nodes.reason: 机器人已停在吧台旁。右侧近处是台面和饮水设备，左侧可见岛台与高脚椅。相机画面确认已到达茶水间吧台区域。
nodes.reasonEn: The robot has stopped beside the counter. The countertop and water dispenser are close on the right, with the island and bar stools on the left. The robot camera confirms arrival in the pantry counter area.
